known_sims.tooltip: QManager remembers the SIMs it has seen, so it only alerts you when a genuinely new SIM is inserted. Clearing forgets every SIM except the one currently inserted.
known_sims.clear_dialog_description: This forgets every SIM QManager has seen, except the one currently inserted — so your active SIM won't be flagged as new. Previously-used SIMs will alert again the next time they are inserted.

sim_registry.title: Tracked SIMs
sim_registry.description: Every SIM QManager has seen, and whether it still raises a new-SIM alert.
sim_registry.stale_notice: Showing the last successful read. The device didn't answer the latest refresh.
sim_registry.empty_description: QManager records each SIM the first time it is inserted. Insert a SIM to start the list.
sim_registry.toast_restored_detail: QManager will alert again when the {{carrier}} SIM is inserted.
sim_registry.toast_restore_failed: Couldn't turn the alert back on
sim_registry.toast_cleared_partial: Cleared, but the list may be stale
sim_registry.toast_cleared_partial_detail: The device forgot the SIMs but couldn't update this list. Reload the page to check.
sim_registry.error_description: The device didn't answer. Nothing has been forgotten — this is a read failure, and the list is still on the modem.

card.title: SSH Access
card.description: The root password for SSH sessions into this modem. It is separate from the password you sign in to QManager with.

current.label: Your QManager password
current.consequence: Proves it is you. This is the web password you signed in with, not the SSH one.

new.label: New SSH password
new.consequence: At least six characters. Takes effect immediately — existing SSH sessions stay open.

errors.too_short: SSH password must be at least 6 characters.

page.title: System Settings
page.description: How this device keeps time, who can reach it, and which SIMs it remembers.

reboot.caption_no_day: Enabled, but no day is selected

card.title: Time & Units
card.description: How this modem keeps time, and the units every reading is shown in.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.consequence: The modem has no battery clock. This is what every log line, event and schedule is measured against.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.consequence: Applies to every temperature reading in QManager.

distance.label: Distance
distance.consequence: Applies to tower distance on the cell scanner and antenna pages.

states.error_body: QManager couldn't read this device's preferences. Nothing has been changed — the zone and units already saved are still in force on the modem.
states.error_body_detail: QManager couldn't read this device's preferences. Nothing has been changed — the zone and units already saved are still in force on the modem. The device said: {{detail}}
states.stale: The modem didn't answer the last request. What's shown is the last state it confirmed.
states.tz_not_applied_body: Saved as {{zone}}, but the device clock is still running at {{offset}}. It may catch up shortly, or this firmware may be missing that zone's data.

card.title: Scheduled Reboot
card.description: Restart the modem automatically on a fixed weekly schedule.

enabled.label: Automatic reboot
enabled.consequence: The modem restarts on this schedule. Your session drops for about ninety seconds and comes back on its own.

time.label: Time
time.consequence: Local device time, not your browser's.

days.label: Repeat on
days.consequence: With no day selected the schedule never fires.

error.title: Can't read the reboot schedule
error.description: QManager couldn't load this device's reboot schedule. Any schedule already saved is still armed on the modem — this is a read failure, not a disarm.

states.stale: QManager lost contact while refreshing. These are the last values it read from the device.

toast.unsaved: Reboot schedule change wasn’t saved — you left the page before it could save.
toast.not_armed: Reboot schedule saved, but it couldn't be armed on this device — {{detail}}

reasons.unit_absent: the scheduling service isn't installed on this device yet — update to the latest firmware to enable it
reasons.no_schedule: no schedule is configured to arm

rejected.no_days: Pick at least one day, or turn the schedule off.
rejected.invalid_time: That time isn't valid. Use a 24-hour HH:MM time.
rejected.network: Couldn't reach the device to save. Check the connection and try again.

page.title: System Logs
page.description: QManager keeps its log in memory on the modem, so it starts empty after every reboot and never wears the flash. Filter it here to see what each component has been doing.

card.title: Transcript
card.description: Showing {{shown}} lines. The live log holds {{held}}.

notice.stale: QManager lost contact while refreshing. These are the last lines it read from the device.

empty.title: The log is empty
empty.description: QManager keeps its log in memory and clears it on every reboot, so nothing has been written since this device last started.

empty_filtered.title: Nothing matches these filters
empty_filtered.description: The log has lines in it, but none of them match the level, component or search you picked.

error.title: Can't read the log
error.description: QManager couldn't reach the log reader on this device. The log itself is untouched, so this is a read failure and not a loss.

clear_dialog.title: Clear the system log?
clear_dialog.description: This empties the live log and deletes both archived files. Anything already written is gone for good, and new lines start arriving immediately.

actions.refresh_aria: Refresh the installed languages and the community catalog

display.title: Display language

remove.title: Remove {{language}}?
remove.description: This deletes the downloaded {{language}} pack from this device. You can install it again at any time.
remove.description_active: {{language}} is the language you are reading right now. Removing it switches QManager back to English.

community.title: Community packs
community.description: Translation packs published for QManager by the community. Installing one adds it to the list above.

failure.manual: Nothing on the device was changed. You can install this pack by hand over SSH:

unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the pack catalog
unreachable.description: The device couldn't load the community pack list from GitHub. Your installed languages are untouched — this is a read that failed, and nothing on the modem has changed.

none.title: No community packs yet
none.description: Nobody has published a downloadable translation pack for QManager yet. The languages above are built into the firmware and are always available.

toast.switch_failed_detail: It may need to be installed again.

errors.generic: The language pack couldn't be installed.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The download failed its integrity check and was discarded.
errors.sha256_mismatch: The download failed its integrity check and was discarded.
errors.insufficient_space: There isn't enough free space on the device to install this pack.
errors.download_failed: The device couldn't download the pack. Check its connection and try again.
errors.manifest_fetch_failed: The device couldn't reach the pack catalog on GitHub.
errors.incompatible: This pack needs a newer version of QManager.
errors.extract_failed: The pack archive couldn't be unpacked.
errors.validate_failed: The pack failed validation and was discarded.
errors.pack_not_found: That pack is no longer listed in the catalog.
errors.install_in_progress: Another language pack is already installing.

page.title: Connection Quality
page.description: The modem pings four endpoints in a fixed order and stops at the first one that answers. Two separate cuts decide when slow or lossy is reported as a network event.

internet.caption_unknown: The probe daemon is not reporting

latency.caption: Average {{avg}} ms, low {{min}} ms, high {{max}} ms

loss.caption: Measured across {{samples}} samples
loss.caption_none: Fewer than 10 samples in the window, so loss is not measured yet

leg.caption_hostname: A hostname leg answered, which is normal
leg.caption_fallback: The chain fell through to an IPv4 literal, so DNS on this device is not resolving

targets.title: Probe Targets
targets.description: The four endpoints this modem pings to decide whether the internet is reachable. It tries them in order and stops at the first answer.
targets.note_fallback: The last two legs are IPv4 literals, so they need no DNS and a broken resolver is never read as a lost connection. Hostnames are rejected in those two slots.
targets.note_watchdog: How often the modem probes, and how many failures count as an outage, are set in the

kind.host: A hostname, so the resolver picks the address family.
kind.ip: An IPv4 literal, so it needs no DNS lookup.

error.title: Can't read the probe targets
error.body: QManager couldn't read this device's probe targets. Nothing has been changed — the targets already saved are still in force on the modem.
error.body_detail: QManager couldn't read this device's probe targets. Nothing has been changed — the targets already saved are still in force on the modem. The device said: {{detail}}

empty.title: No probe chain saved
empty.body: This device has no probe targets recorded yet. Restore the defaults to give it a chain to ping.

validation.disallowed: Contains characters that are not allowed.
validation.ipv4_required: This slot needs an IPv4 address. A hostname is not accepted here.

thresholds.title: Quality Thresholds
thresholds.description: The two cuts that decide when a slow or lossy connection is reported as a network event.

blurb.latency_standard: For good cellular. Flags latency that stays above 150 ms.
blurb.latency_tolerant: For average cellular. Allows the occasional spike before flagging.
blurb.latency_very_tolerant: For poor-signal areas. Flags only when latency stays high.
blurb.loss_standard: A tight quality bar. Flags loss above 15 percent.
blurb.loss_tolerant: Acceptable on cellular under load. Won't fire from short bursts.
blurb.loss_very_tolerant: Severe drops only. Useful in poor-signal areas.

thresholds.footer: Both of these are alerting cuts. Nothing here restarts the modem — recovery lives in the Connection Watchdog.
thresholds.default_note: This device has nothing saved yet, so the built-in defaults are shown. Saving writes them to the modem.

error.title: Can't read the quality thresholds
error.body: QManager couldn't read this device's thresholds. Nothing has been changed — the cuts already saved are still in force on the modem.
